adjudication.rationale: In `minimumTokenResponseSchema` the two computed properties use `z.string().toString()` and `z.string().optional().toString()` as object keys. Those expressions evaluate to strings at runtime, so they become normal object-literal keys, and (very plausibly) stringify to the same value, meaning the latter definition overwrites the former. Even aside from the overwrite, this is not a valid way to express “any key with a number value” in Zod; the schema ends up not enforcing the intended numeric-expiry contract and effectively doesn’t validate dynamic token fields as documented.
